sloka: जगत् सर्वं शरीरं ते स्थैर्यं ते वसुधातलम् ।अग्निः कोपः प्रसादस्ते सोमः श्रीवत्सलक्षणः ।। ६.१२०.२७ ।।
transliteration: jagat sarvaṁ śarīraṁ te sthairyaṁ te vasudhātalam ।agniḥ kopaḥ prasādaste somaḥ śrīvatsalakṣaṇaḥ ।। 6.120.27 ।।

translations.english: "Before you took the form of Trivikrama, and took three strides, occupied the three worlds and bound the dreadful king Bali you made Mahendra as king of heaven."
